basic_details.short_information: The Kerala University (KU) has officially announced the Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification has been published at https://www.keralauniversity.ac.in/. Candidates holding a Master's Degree in Life Sciences (Zoology, Botany, Biology, or allied disciplines) can attend the walk-in interview on 05 August 2026. Candidates should refer to the official notification for age limit details. Direct links to download the official notification and walk-in interview details are provided below.

Kerala University Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Kerala University Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Kerala University recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Kerala University recruitment is Field Investigator. This is a contractual position offered by the university.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Life Sciences, including disciplines such as Zoology, Botany, Biology, or other allied subjects to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Field Investigator position at Kerala University is scheduled to take place on 05 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Field Investigator in this recruitment drive announced by Kerala University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this job is Walk-in. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview venue.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview venue is located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, with the pincode 695581. The exact address will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Field Investigator position is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a specific period as per the terms and conditions of the university.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age limit mentioned for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The specific age limit details for the Field Investigator post have not been explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any age restrictions or relaxation details.
